rationale: C02 is a highly plausible drafting template: both orders concern Hawaii lands previously reserved for the Navy, use nearly identical recitals stating that the lands are no longer needed and that restoration to the Territory of Hawaii is advisable and in the public interest, and then provide a metes-and-bounds survey beginning with coordinates tied to a Government Survey triangulation station and continuing by true azimuths. C05 and C14 employ the same restoration machinery, but C02 also matches the Navy-specific factual setting most closely.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS such lands and the improvements thereon are no longer needed by the Navy Department for use as a radio station, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that they be restored to the use of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS these lands are no longer needed for the use of the Navy Department, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that they be restored to the use of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive near-verbatim recital with the same department, disposition, and public-interest determination.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The following-described lands... are hereby restored to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: restoring certain lands the jurisdiction the territory hawaii
shared_material.explanation: Both directives use the same substantive land-restoration mechanism for federally reserved lands in Hawaii.

shared_material.child_excerpt: BEGINNING at a 2-inch pipe... the coordinates of said point of beginning referred to Government Survey Trig. Station "Puolo"... as shown on Government Survey registered Map No. 2615, and running by true azimuths
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Beginning at a spike in concrete... the coordinates of said point of beginning referred to Government Survey Triangulation Station "Halai"... as shown on Government Survey Registered Map NO. 2539, and running by true azimuths
shared_material.explanation: Parallel and unusually specific survey-description formula, adapted to a different parcel and survey station.
